title: JSON Schemas for mappingScheme, mappingRule, provenance, and review artifacts (+ CI validation)
context: open-transliteration needs machine-readable, validated data artifacts for mapping schemes, individual rules, source provenance entries, and per-scheme review records. These schemas live in packages/schema alongside the existing taskSchema/registrySchema and are the validation backbone for every downstream scheme task. Without them, no data task can have a CI gate.
objective: Author and export AJV draft-07 JSON Schemas — mappingSchemeSchema, mappingRuleSchema, provenanceSchema, reviewSchema — in packages/schema/src, compiled and exported identically to the existing taskSchema, with CI validation wired so any invalid scheme data or provenance entry fails the build immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/schema/src exports mappingSchemeSchema, mappingRuleSchema, provenanceSchema, and reviewSchema (AJV draft-07, additionalProperties: false on all top-level objects)

mappingSchemeSchema requires: id, name, sourceScript (ISO 15924), targetScript (ISO 15924), direction (bidirectional|forward|inverse), reversibility (strict|normalized|lossy), normalizationForm, provenanceRefs (string[]), license, rules (array of mappingRule), and lossReport (null or string)
mappingRuleSchema requires: from, to, and reversibleInverse (boolean); allows optional contextBefore and contextAfter

provenanceSchema requires: id, name, url, version, retrievalDate, licenseName, licenseUrl, licenseTextSnapshot, derivativesAllowed (boolean), attributionString, snapshotHash (SHA-256 hex), and verifiedBy/verifiedDate; allows optional snapshotArchiveUrl and notes; allows status: excluded with excludedReason
reviewSchema requires: schemeId, reviewerName, reviewDate, coiDeclaration, verdict (approved|rejected|conditional), and agentFlags (array of {flag, type, status, resolution?})
pnpm build && pnpm test passes with schemas compiled to dist/; pnpm lint passes
A minimal smoke-test validates one valid and one invalid instance per schema in CI
resources: PLAN.md — Solution approach & architecture (packages/schema, data model)
packages/schema/src/schemas.ts — existing taskSchema pattern to follow
output: packages/schema/src additions for the four new schemas; updated dist/ exports; smoke-test file in packages/schema/src/__tests__/ or similar
